title: Biefeld-Brown effect and Townsend Brown

tellings.quote: have been discovered like the Biffield Brown effect, which you know, I'm obsessed with this Townsen Brown character,

plain: There is something called the Biefeld-Brown effect, in which electrically charged devices seem to push themselves along, and it is tied to an inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown. Michels names it himself in passing, as an example of a discovery that has been made, and says he is "obsessed with this Townsend Brown character."
